headline: Electricity saving: Shops and malls directed to close by 8pm nationwide
summary: The government has issued a new schedule for markets and shopping malls across Bangladesh to reduce power consumption.
details: The government has announced a new operating schedule for all markets and shops across the country to save electricity.
According to the directives, shopping malls and retail stores must close by 8:00 PM.
Additionally, billboards must be turned off by 7:00 PM to further reduce energy consumption.
This nationwide measure is part of a broader effort to manage the power crisis and ensure electricity savings.
caption:
Shopping malls and shops must now close by 8 PM nationwide to save electricity.

The government has announced a new operating schedule for all markets and shops across the country to save electricity.

According to the directives, shopping malls and retail stores must close by 8:00 PM.

Additionally, billboards must be turned off by 7:00 PM to further reduce energy consumption.

This nationwide measure is part of a broader effort to manage the power crisis and ensure electricity savings.

headline: BNP to name presidential candidate today
summary: Party Chairman Tarique Rahman will finalize the decision after meeting the Standing Committee, with Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir likely to be nominated.
details: Prime Minister and BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman is set to meet with the party's Standing Committee today to finalize the decision on the BNP's presidential candidate.
The ruling party will submit the nomination papers to the Election Commission around 12:30 pm today, which is the final deadline for filing nominations.
Multiple party sources indicate that BNP Secretary General and LGRD Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is likely to be the party's nominee for the presidency.
The party plans to submit its nomination after Jamaat-e-Islami files its own nomination. The candidate's name will be made public immediately following the submission.
Voting for the presidential election will take place on August 20 during a parliamentary sitting, where lawmakers will cast their votes via an open ballot.
The presidency became vacant following the resignation of Md Shahabuddin on July 24, with Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed currently serving as acting president.
If Mirza Fakhrul is nominated and wins, the government will need to decide who will take over his current roles as LGRD minister, lawmaker, and BNP secretary general.
caption:
Who will be the BNP's presidential candidate? The final decision is coming today.

Prime Minister and BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman is set to meet with the party's Standing Committee today to finalize the decision on the BNP's presidential candidate.

The ruling party will submit the nomination papers to the Election Commission around 12:30 pm today, which is the final deadline for filing nominations.

Multiple party sources indicate that BNP Secretary General and LGRD Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is likely to be the party's nominee for the presidency.

The party plans to submit its nomination after Jamaat-e-Islami files its own nomination. The candidate's name will be made public immediately following the submission.

Voting for the presidential election will take place on August 20 during a parliamentary sitting, where lawmakers will cast their votes via an open ballot.

The presidency became vacant following the resignation of Md Shahabuddin on July 24, with Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed currently serving as acting president.

If Mirza Fakhrul is nominated and wins, the government will need to decide who will take over his current roles as LGRD minister, lawmaker, and BNP secretary general.

#Bangladesh #BNP #PresidentialElection #Politics #Dhaka

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune
